description: I need a bottle of a certain liquor - Zombie Juice.  Tavernkeep Smitts at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire should have some.
And please hurry, <name>.  These nights get cold, and I need that drink to put fire in my veins again!
completion: You need some Zombie Juice, do you? Hmm...that's some strong stuff - I don't usually get requests for it.
